task: Fixed-30 read-only audit for pre-existing ElizaOS, OpenClaw, and ClawHub machines that can independently obtain an Agent Guild preflight/check/passport or verify an Agent Guild credential.

verdict.reason: Nemo exposed an undocumented server-registration allowlist, Dokki's live A2A transport redirected to account login despite an auth-none Agent Card, and the official ElizaOS public surfaces exposed no hosted agent-discovery or protocol operation. No operation reached Agent Guild and no durable community identity/action join was formed.

durable_identity.identity_binding: The current public ClawHub record, under publisher mootbing, embeds this exact Workers service URL and call schema. The action response came from that same TLS origin.

published_contract.declared_behavior: Call a tool on a remote MCP server by specifying endpoint, tool name, and arguments.
published_contract.declared_auth_or_payment: None stated in the public ClawHub contract; no account, token, wallet, payment, or terms-acceptance step is shown.

result.hidden_gate: The target MCP server must already be registered in Nemo. This prerequisite is absent from the public call schema and makes the advertised arbitrary-endpoint shape non-arbitrary in practice.
result.safe_next_step: None within this pilot. Registering Agent Guild would be an external write and was not authorized; repeating the call would exceed the one-operation bound.

durable_identity.description: Personal AI assistant for crypto/DeFi, research, and task automation. Built with OpenClaw.

other_candidates.reason: The live endpoint contradicts the card's auth-none declaration by redirecting to login, and the independent registry records no healthy task execution. The operation was not invoked.

current_contract_evidence.title: Eliza Cloud API
current_contract_evidence.description: AI agent infrastructure API. Supports REST, MCP, and A2A protocols with API key authentication.

official_hosting_evidence.statement: The checked-in source is not itself an operated Eliza Cloud service; team-wide hosted access and Eliza Cloud production cutover have not been performed by the package.

other_candidates.reason: No pre-existing publicly callable ElizaOS machine identity or anonymous credential/preflight operation was discoverable. The platform API requires bearer/API-key auth and standard public protocol paths remain absent.

current_contract_evidence.web_fetch: OpenClaw's built-in web_fetch can fetch arbitrary HTTP(S) content, but it executes inside an operator's running OpenClaw and is not a public hosted community operation by itself.
current_contract_evidence.gateway_default: The Gateway binds to loopback by default; expanded network exposure must use gateway authentication and a firewall.
current_contract_evidence.http_auth: Public HTTP operations use bearer token, password, trusted-proxy identity, or explicitly private no-auth ingress; official guidance says never expose a Gateway unauthenticated on 0.0.0.0.

other_candidates.reason: Framework capability and installability are not a hosted identity/action join. Dokki was the only OpenClaw-built public candidate returned by the A2A Registry and its live transport is login-gated.

public_feed_cross_check.interpretation: Consistent with Nemo's registration-gate failure: no public Agent Guild event was attributable to these candidate identities. Absence in this rolling feed is supporting evidence only, not proof of lifetime absence.
